title: Asia's chip rout: Taiwan loses 12% in a week and the Nikkei 6% in a day, while India gains 8.6%
short: Asia's chip rout: Taiwan −12% for the week, India +8.6%
dek: Fears of US curbs on AI data centres hammered Taiwan, Korea and Japan. Hong Kong and China held up, oil fell more than 16%, and Indian shares drew foreign money.
card: Taiex −12.19% for the week, Kospi −6.02% and Nikkei −5.96% on Friday. Shanghai ended a six-week slide. What it means for India.
